items.exampleEn: The old letter was closed with a red seal.
items.exampleZh: 那封舊信用紅色的封印封口。

items.exampleEn: She undertook the job of writing the school's history.
items.exampleZh: 她接下了撰寫校史的工作。

items.exampleEn: Several cities are bidding to host next year's music festival.
items.exampleZh: 有好幾個城市在爭取主辦明年的音樂節。

items.exampleEn: The waves slapped against the side of the boat.
Tackling climate change needs help from every country.
items.exampleZh: 對付氣候變遷需要每個國家的幫忙。

items.exampleEn: Ships have sailed between these islands for hundreds of years.
items.exampleZh: 幾百年來，船隻一直在這些島嶼之間航行。

items.exampleEn: The child had a firm grasp on her mother's hand.
items.exampleZh: 那個孩子緊緊抓著媽媽的手。

items.exampleEn: Some ads manipulate people into buying things they don't need.
items.exampleZh: 有些廣告操縱人們去買自己不需要的東西。

items.sentenceEn: The children sailed their paper boats on the pond.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們在池塘上放他們的紙船。

items.audioEn: Our team will tackle the most difficult problem first, before lunch.
items.audioZh: 我們團隊會在午餐前先處理最困難的問題。
options: Order lunch for everyone in the office
Call the clients who complained yesterday

items.sentenceEn: Please check that the seal on the juice bottle is not broken.
items.sentenceZh: 請檢查果汁瓶的封口有沒有破損。

items.sentenceEn: He slapped a mosquito on his arm.
items.sentenceZh: 他拍死了手臂上的一隻蚊子。

items.stemEn: The company will ____ a big project to build a new hospital.
items.stemZh: 那家公司將承接興建新醫院的大型計畫。

items.stemEn: She has a good ____ of Japanese, so she can read the menu easily.
items.stemZh: 她很懂日文，所以能輕鬆看懂菜單。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my uncle undertook a big challenge: he sailed alone around Taiwan in his small boat. Before leaving, he checked that every food box had a tight seal, so sea water could not get in. Safety was always his top priority. On the third day, strong winds hit, but he knew the sea well and tackled the problem calmly. He had learned to manipulate the boat's controls with just one hand. When he returned to the harbor after two weeks, his friends slapped him on the back and cheered. Now he wants to bid for an old wooden boat that will be sold next month.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我叔叔接下了一項大挑戰：他獨自駕著小船繞台灣一圈。出發前，他確認每個食物盒都密封好，海水才進不去。安全一直是他的第一優先。第三天颳起了強風，但他很熟悉大海，冷靜地處理了問題。他早就學會只用一隻手操控船上的控制裝置。兩週後他回到港口時，朋友們拍拍他的背，為他歡呼。現在他想出價買下一艘下個月要拍賣的舊木船。

items.promptZh: 這個機器手臂可以操作很小的零件。
referenceEn: This robot arm can manipulate very small parts.
The robot arm is able to manipulate tiny parts.
rubricZh: 「可以」可寫，例如 can、is able to 等

items.promptZh: 她打算下班前先把那一大堆還沒回的郵件處理掉。
referenceEn: Before leaving work, she planned to tackle the big pile of emails she hadn't answered.
Before she leaves the office, she plans to tackle the pile of emails she hasn't replied to.
rubricZh: tackle 指「處理、解決」（例如 tackle the pile of emails 等）
「還沒回的郵件」可寫，例如 emails she hadn't answered、emails she hasn't replied to 等
「下班前」可寫，例如 before leaving work、before she leaves the office 等
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 planned、plans、is planning 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：疑似搭配不自然："He used a small computer to manipulate the sails." 調帆英文常說 adjust/trim the sails，用電腦 manipulate 帆也不太合帆船實況；且 manipulate 的單字卡例句是負面「操縱人」，此處義項不一致。建議改寫成較合理的操作情境（如 manipulate the controls）。
